purpose: Test a deployable retrieval baseline using intact native contextual motif codes after the learned code distribution failed both before and after normalization. Determine whether real code sequences preserve scaffold validity when transferred to a different isolated query. This is not new model training or proof of learned generalization.
panel: First protein in each128/256/384/512bucket in the original selected order. Four queries and four original noise slots each. These are the same four queries as the normalization profile, chosen by original order, not generated outcomes.
retrieval: Search every contiguous20-residue window of the7893 certified training proteins, excluding every family in the32query and16validation panels. Match query length bucket. Select the four distinct donor families minimizing max(properCA RMSD,dRMS), breaking ties by RMSD,dRMS,donorID,start. The branch bound dRMS<=joint-score threshold is exact and is tested against exhaustive search. Preserve native code arrays bit-for-bit; no averaging, target re-encoding, latent rotation, or projection. Query input consists only of isolated motif geometry, length and position. Supplied query sequence is reserved for the subsequent fixed-motif design assay.
control: Four distinct hash-selected training donor families in the same length bucket, independent of query geometry; choose a hash-selected valid20-residue window in each. Seed2026100911. All32query/16validation families remain excluded. Both arms use actual complete native context codes; only input-based retrieval versus random donor selection differs.
sampler: Original frozen459M unconditional50Euler/AE3/RePaint3, FP32, original target IDs and scaffold/motif/decoder seeds2026100405. One donor-code sample per noise slot; no retries or generated-output ranking. All failures retained.
controls: Replay all16 original oracle outputs on four queries: latentmaxabs<=1e-5, CA RMSD<=.2A,lDDT>=.99, identical raw/valid decisions. Additionally run four noise samples for the first retrieved donor of each query at the donor's actual length and motif placement. These16 donor-self samples test the transferred-code data source; they are controls, not query predictions or replacements. Independent CPU audit verifies all code arrays against source reference_z, donor exclusions, nearest-neighbor certificates, random selection, and original query constraints.
qualification: Require at least8/16valid retrieved-query samples, at least2/16raw original-query motif matches, and more raw query matches than the random arm. Require at least8/16coarse-valid donor-self samples and all16historical oracle controls. This licenses a separately frozen full128x2 retrieval assay, not a designability claim or automatic training. A failed profile closes this retrieval recipe without changing distance thresholds, donor count or sampling steps.
refolding_boundary: No refolding in this profile. Any full assay must use the original eight fixed-motif ProteinMPNN designs per output and same-valid-refold motif/global/scaffold criterion, with original parent/native controls and family-bootstrap contrasts. A usable teacher must beat parent8strict in7families and retain45designable outputs, and be compared with the random-code control before any student training.
resources: One RTX,10minute allocation and480second worker cap;64 newbackbones:16retrieved,16random,16oracle replay,16donor-self. CPU preparation/scoring outside allocation, frozen sources, registered completion watcher, at most8 own running-plus-pending GPUs.
